card: Cleans up boilerplate and redundant synchronization calls across functional tests. It removes unnecessary sync_blocks calls already handled by helpers, replaces manual block creation with generateblock(submit=False), and adopts send_self_transfer_chain. The author characterizes these as style-only test fixups following review feedback on PR #35728.
evidence: Commit messages cite review suggestions from L0rinc on PR #35728.
Author description: 'Just a few random sync style-only test-only fixups. See the commit msgs for the rationales.'
problem: Functional tests contain verbose boilerplate and redundant block synchronization calls that newer test framework helpers simplify.

risk.why: Incorrect test synchronization could cause flaky functional test failures in CI.

summary: Cleans up redundant synchronization calls and modernizes helper usage in functional tests. It removes unnecessary sync_blocks calls that are already handled internally by test framework methods, replaces manual block construction from templates with generateblock(submit=False), and replaces manual transaction chaining with send_self_transfer_chain.
